project.title: GlassBar
project.tagline: A Flutter navigation bar package with glassmorphism, adaptive layouts, and flexible interaction behavior.

summary.short: GlassBar is a Flutter navigation package supporting horizontal and vertical layouts, pinned or auto-hidden panels, controlled and uncontrolled selection, theming, badges, accessibility, and optional haptics.
summary.long: The package includes configurable blur, selected indicators, drag-to-change-tab behavior, safe-area handling, panel timing, responsive extent constraints, accessibility semantics, CI, and a GitHub Pages demo.

highlights: Horizontal bottom bar and vertical sidebar layouts
Flexible theming, accessibility, badges, and haptics
